source: Server_configuration.txt derived from ark.wiki.gg Server configuration
curation: ChatGPT curated from DeepSeek extraction; no undocumented source gaps were invented.

load_policy.dynamic_config: load only for explicit dynamic/live requests
load_policy.content_niche: load only for clearly matching niche/map/content requests

safety_rules: unsupported, obsolete and unverified settings are rejected for automatic application.
AI output never writes INI directly; it must pass structured validation and preview.

settings.name: MaxPlayers
settings.description: Specifies the maximum number of players. In ASA, this is replaced by -WinLiveMaxPlayers.
settings.curation_note: support=unsupported

settings.name: ActiveMapMod
settings.description: Specifies which mod map is loaded.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: ActiveMods
settings.description: Specifies the order and which mods are loaded. Comma-separated list, no spaces. Priority descending.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: ActiveTotalConversion
settings.description: Used to specify a total conversion mod.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: -ActiveEvent
settings.description: Enables a specified event. Obsolete in ASA, use -mods argument instead.
settings.curation_note: support=obsolete

settings.name: -automanagedmods
settings.description: Steam only, automatic MOD download/installation/updating. Obsolete in ASA, use -mods.
settings.curation_note: support=obsolete

settings.name: -crossplay
settings.description: Enables crossplay between EPIC and Steam. Obsolete in ASA, use -ServerPlatform.
settings.curation_note: support=obsolete

settings.name: -EasterColors
settings.description: Chance for Easter colors when creatures spawn.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: -epiconly
settings.description: Enables Epic Game Store only players to connect. Obsolete since ASA is not available on Epic.
settings.curation_note: support=obsolete

settings.name: -imprintlimit
settings.description: Automatically destroys creatures exceeding the imprinting bonus limit specified, in %. Recommended to use 101.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: -MapModID
settings.description: Loads custom maps via ModID. Obsolete in ASA, use -mods.
settings.curation_note: support=obsolete

settings.name: -NewYearEvent
settings.description: Enables the ARK: Happy New Year! event; automatically starts at Midnight EST and Noon EST on Jan 1 unless specified.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: -NoDinosExceptForcedSpawn
settings.description: Prevents wild creatures from being spawned, except for forced spawns. Undocumented.
settings.curation_note: support=unverified

settings.name: -NoDinosExceptManualSpawn
settings.description: Prevents wild creatures from being spawned, except for manual spawns. Undocumented.
settings.curation_note: support=unverified

settings.name: -NoDinosExceptStreamingSpawn
settings.description: Prevents wild creatures from being spawned, except for streaming spawns. Undocumented.
settings.curation_note: support=unverified

settings.name: -NoDinosExceptWaterSpawn
settings.description: Prevents wild creatures from being spawned, except for water spawns. Undocumented.
settings.curation_note: support=unverified

settings.name: -PublicIPForEpic
settings.description: This is the public IP that EGS clients will attempt to connect to.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: -ServerUseEventColors
settings.description: Enables event colors.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: -TotalConversionMod
settings.description: Used to specify a total conversion mod.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: -UseVivox
settings.description: Enables Vivox on Steam only servers.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: ?GameModIds
settings.description: Specifies order and which mods are loaded. Obsolete in ASA, use -mods.
settings.curation_note: support=obsolete

settings.name: ?NewYear1UTC
settings.description: Used with -NewYearEvent to set custom event start time.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.

settings.name: ?NewYear2UTC
settings.description: Used with -NewYearEvent to set custom event end time.
settings.curation_note: Excluded from normal ASA automation; legacy/platform-specific/event-specific or superseded usage.
